from pathlib import Path

# Check file sizes
files_to_check = [
    ('Global', [
        ('~/.claude/memory/common-errors.md', Path.home() / '.claude/memory/common-errors.md'),
        ('~/.claude/memory/lessons-learned.md', Path.home() / '.claude/memory/lessons-learned.md'),
        ('~/.claude/memory/session-history.md', Path.home() / '.claude/memory/session-history.md'),
    ]),
    ('Project', [
        ('.claude/memory/project/current-session.md', Path('.claude/memory/project/current-session.md')),
        ('.claude/memory/project/project-errors.md', Path('.claude/memory/project/project-errors.md')),
        ('.claude/memory/project/project-lessons.md', Path('.claude/memory/project/project-lessons.md')),
    ]),
    ('Agent', [
        ('.claude/memory/agents/au-promotion/session-memory.md', 
         Path('.claude/memory/agents/au-promotion/session-memory.md')),
    ])
]

print("=== MEMORY SYSTEM HEALTH CHECK ===\n")

max_size = 8 * 1024  # 8KB limit per file
total_by_tier = {}

for tier_name, tier_files in files_to_check:
    print(f"{tier_name} Memory:")
    tier_total = 0
    
    for display_name, file_path in tier_files:
        if file_path.exists():
            size = file_path.stat().st_size
            tier_total += size
            percent = (size / max_size) * 100
            
            status = "HEALTHY"
            if percent >= 85:
                status = "CRITICAL"
            elif percent >= 80:
                status = "WARNING"
            
            print(f"  {display_name.split('/')[-1]:30s} {size:>6,} bytes ({percent:>5.1f}%) {status}")
        else:
            print(f"  {display_name.split('/')[-1]:30s} NOT FOUND")
    
    tier_max = 24 * 1024  # 24KB tier limit
    tier_percent = (tier_total / tier_max) * 100
    total_by_tier[tier_name] = (tier_total, tier_percent)
    print(f"  {'Total:':30s} {tier_total:>6,} bytes ({tier_percent:>5.1f}%)")
    print()

# Overall system health
overall_total = sum(t[0] for t in total_by_tier.values())
print(f"Overall System: {overall_total:,} bytes across all tiers")
print(f"\nStatus: All files monitored for health")

EOFPYTHON
